359:t_1:83.en:
$$ボス$$
「No... it's worse than back then. Even when $$赤木$$ talks to him, he won't so much as look him in the eye.」

359:t_1:84.en:
$$甲児$$
「Yeah... It's like he regrets even being alive.」

359:t_1:85.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「Why don't we have $n, who's close to no longer being the quiet type, coach him?」

359:t_1:88.en:
$n
「$$甲児$$... You said just now that he seems to regret even being alive.」

359:t_1:90.en:
$n
「That's surely the state $$シンジ$$ is in right now. ...All we can do is wait.」

359:t_1:91.en:
$$アルト$$
「So there's nothing we can do.」

359:t_1:92.en:
$n
「I just hope he finds something that helps him move his own feelings forward, even a little...」

359:t_1:94.en:
$$シュレード$$
(The one who also bothers me is that boy calling himself $$渚カヲル$$...)

359:t_1:95.en:
$$シュレード$$
(The boy who showed up back then to listen to my piano... Was that him...?)

359:t_1:96.en:
$$マリ$$
「Hmm... Puppy's got a rough road ahead, nya.」

359:t_1:97.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You never change, $$マリ$$. Always at your own pace.」

359:t_1:98.en:
$$マリ$$
「Well, yeah. I'm not some innocent little girl, after all.」

359:t_1:99.en:
$$ノノ$$
「D-Do you mean... she looks like a girl, but her real age is...!」

359:t_1:100.en:
$$ラルク$$
「She's not an android like you. There's no way that's true.」

359:t_1:102.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$アスカ$$, aren't you going to wear the school uniform?」

359:t_1:104.en:
$$カレン$$
「Hey... tell me what happened to $$シンジ$$.」

359:t_1:105.en:
$$アスカ$$
「After we got back to our original world, he and I were on separate missions...」

359:t_1:107.en:
$$カレン$$
「But if it's you, $$アスカ$$, couldn't you ask $$シンジ$$ what happened to him...?」

359:t_1:108.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...Sorry, $$カレン$$. We're not the people we were back then anymore...」

359:t_1:110.en:
$$アスカ$$
「I'm tired too... I'm going to go rest...」

359:t_1:114.en:
$$マリ$$
(If it's tormenting her that much, she should just spill everything, you know?)

359:t_1:115.en:
$$マリ$$
(Something like, 'I may look the same, but a long time has passed since then, and our world is almost completely destroyed'... is what she'd say.)

359:t_1:117.en:
$$アスカ$$
(Everyone's been fighting with everything they have... How could I tell them, 'We ended up in the same state as $$エタニティ・フラット$$'...?)

359:t_1:118.en:
$$マリ$$
(Well... yeah... These kids are so kind that they wouldn't know how to react if she told them that...)

359:t_1:120.en:
$$チコ$$
「Hmm... So that $$アスカ$$ girl gets called 'Princess' too.」

359:t_1:121.en:
$$ノノ$$
「A rival has appeared for Big Sis!」

359:t_1:122.en:
$$ラルク$$
「You... Why do you always take things in that direction?」

359:t_1:123.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But it's exciting, isn't it? A rival appears, a first defeat... and then a comeback through effort and guts!」

359:t_1:124.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Listen... from now on, that girl and we are comrades. How does it turn into fighting and defeat...」

359:t_1:128.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(When $$シンジ$$ and the others and $$アスカ$$ and the others were transferred here, the two groups of EVAs looked like they were in the middle of a fight...)

359:t_1:129.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(What on earth happened to $$シンジ$$ and the others in the three months since the transfer...)

359:t_1:130.en:
$$チコ$$
「Still, those EVA kids all look like a handful.」

359:t_1:133.en:
$$チコ$$
「...Oops, sorry. There's still one more of them, isn't there.」

359:t_1:134.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「$$レイ#pt394$$ didn't wear a uniform either.」

359:t_1:135.en:
$$カレン$$
「But staying in a plugsuit all the time must be tiring, isn't it?」

359:t_1:136.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
「In a moment like this... what would $$綾波レイ$$ do?」

359:t_1:139.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The $$サイデリアル$$ are here already...!」

359:t_1:140.en:
$$アヤナミレイ$$
(Why do these people fight...? Because they're ordered to? Or is it...)

359:t_2:5.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Not at all... Staff Officer $$ナナイ$$ was delighted to learn that you had returned, Colonel, after your whereabouts had been unknown.」

359:t_2:7.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm glad you're safe too, $$マリーダ$$.」

359:t_2:8.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$c is the same as the $$ガランシェール$$ team. Here, I can fight.」

359:t_2:10.en:
$$シャア$$
「$$ジンネマン$$. I want you to stay as you are and defend the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ together with the $$ガランシェール$$ team.」

359:t_2:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「Eventually I intend to have $$ミネバ$$, $$ナナイ$$ and the others come over here as well.」

359:t_2:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That is fine with me, but what will you do, Colonel?」

359:t_2:13.en:
$$シャア$$
「...Indulge my selfishness for a little longer.」

359:t_2:14.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You will be acting together with $c.」

359:t_2:15.en:
$$シャア$$
「Right now, $c needs combat strength. I will lend my help as one more pilot.」

359:t_2:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「If I may be so bold, what Captain $$アムロ$$ and everyone else expect of you, Colonel, is probably more than that.」

359:t_2:17.en:
$$シャア$$
「...I'll think about it, $$マリーダ・クルス$$.」

359:t_2:18.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「Understood, Colonel. While you're away, I will defend the Colony Alliance.」

359:t_2:24.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「I'm counting on you to look after $$マリーダ$$, $$バナージ$$.」
